title: Packaging Investigation Verdict
description: Machine-readable packaging investigation verdict from the packaging-investigation skill. Consumed by package-onboarding via load_investigation_verdict.

verdict.description: Whether the packaging investigation finished successfully.

complexity_score.description: Packaging complexity from 0 (pure Python, trivial) to 10 (extreme native deps / platform-specific builds). Must be 0 when verdict is failed.

observations.description: Key findings or failure reasons discovered during investigation (non-whitespace strings).
